title: Exquisite Chinese Tofu Dumplings
description: A sweet and pillowy Chinese dish featuring marmite and wrapped in lotus leaves, this recipe is a cozy and shojin-friendly delight. The namul-blanch-season method adds a burst of flavor to the dish.
instructions: Rinse the lotus leaves in cold water and blanch them in boiling water for 30 seconds to make them pliable.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the crumbled tofu, marmite, soy sauce, sesame oil, scallions, and ginger, and mix well.
Add the namul to the tofu mixture and stir to combine.
Lay a lotus leaf flat on a work surface and place a tablespoon of the tofu mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the leaf over the filling to form a triangle or a square shape, and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Repeat the process with the remaining lotus leaves and tofu mixture.
Steam the dumplings over boiling water for 10 minutes, or until they are cooked through and the lotus leaves are tender.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with additional scallions and namul if desired.
